g.text: Vision uses clamp/Linear/clamp for all three projections.
Text uses ordinary bias-free Linear projections.
E2B doubles MLP width only in shared-K/V layers.
E4B keeps the same MLP width in every layer.
This primitive graph defines both vision and text MLPs.
Concrete text configuration and layer schedule
E2B: D1536, N35, KV1, F6144, Fs12288, B15. Full layers4,9,14,19,24,29,34; all others sliding.
E4B: D2560, N42, KV2, F10240, Fs10240, B24. Full layers5,11,17,23,29,35,41; all others sliding.
D=width; N=layers; KV=K/V heads; F=base FFN; Fs=shared-layer FFN; B=first shared layer. Both configurations use PLI width256.
